attributes.board_name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-authorized providers; providers with current ACPE or AMA CME Category 1 approval count as authorized providers; postgraduate pharmacy curricula from Board-authorized or ACPE providers
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE required in the calendar year of graduation from an approved school of pharmacy.
rules.carryover: Not allowed; hours cannot be carried from one calendar year to another.
rules.alternatives: Extenuating circumstances: detailed statement under penalties of perjury; the Board decides on renewal.
rules.audit_note: Signed statement under penalties of perjury with the renewal; keep statements of credit at least two years and provide them on request or random audit.

topics.who: All pharmacists: at least 2 contact hours of pharmacy law each calendar year
Pharmacists who oversee or administer vaccines

rules.notes: Registrations expire Dec 31 of even years. Minimum 20 contact hours each calendar year; max 15 h/year by home study or other mediated instruction; max 8 h per day. Sterile compounding: 5 h/year; complex non-sterile compounding: 3 h/year (no topic code).
